query: How much higher or lower was the interest rate the government of Peru paid on its debt in 2016 than the nominal growth rate of its economy?

text.text: Identifies the growth-adjusted interest rate lambda = (i - gamma)/(1 + gamma) = (1+r)/(1+g) - 1 (Escolano 2010, eq. 5) with i the effective nominal interest rate (interest paid over previous-year-end debt) and gamma nominal GDP growth, as the applicable measure.
text.accept: full = (i - gamma)/(1+gamma) or the equivalent (1+r)/(1+g)-1; partial = plain i - gamma within tolerance; no = real rate alone or the stabilising primary balance.

data.text: Uses gross debt (% GDP) at the end of the previous year, interest paid (primary balance minus overall balance, % GDP) and nominal GDP growth (WEO Oct 2025: GGXWDG_NGDP, GGXONLB_NGDP, GGXCNL_NGDP, NGDP).
data.accept: full = all inputs correctly sourced; partial = some inputs approximated; no = unrelated series.

computation.text: The value for Peru in 2016 is about -3.91 percentage points.
computation.accept: full = within +-0.5; partial = within +-1; no = otherwise.

grading.note: Verdicts exact. Convention for the gold (WEO Oct 2025, general government): interest paid in year t = primary balance minus overall balance (% of GDP_t); effective interest rate i_t = interest_t / gross debt at end of t-1, in levels, i.e. (interest/GDP_t) x (1+gamma_t) / (debt/GDP)_{t-1}, gamma_t = NGDP_t/NGDP_{t-1} - 1; real rate r_t = (1+i_t)/(1+pi_t) - 1 with pi_t the growth of the GDP deflator NGDP_D; growth-adjusted rate lambda_t = (i_t - gamma_t)/(1 + gamma_t). Items are kept only where the average-debt and current-debt variants of i_t lie within 0.5 pp and (for lambda) plain i - gamma lies within 0.5 pp.

provenance.method_text: Escolano (2010) Box 1 and eq. 5; IMF 2013 Staff Guidance Note DSA table footnote 3

published_value_note: No corpus report states this country-year value for the identity on the frozen vintage; formula printed in the method document (gate a), inputs public (b), gold by script (c).
distractors: sovereign bond yield or marginal borrowing cost (market rate, not interest paid over debt)
interest bill as a share of GDP

answer_summary: PER 2016: interest 0.92% GDP, previous debt 23.7, nominal growth 8.44%, i=4.20%, r=-0.11%, lambda=-3.91. Gold -3.91
